value.rationale: A natural two-parameter family of near-ordinary numerical semigroups receives a complete rather than finite classification of all normalized reflexive ideals, with a bijective regular-language model, exact rational generating series and strictly varying entropy/growth constant. This answers a concrete quantitative question motivated by recent reflexive-ideal literature, rather than a parameter renaming or isolated finite census. The containment order on these ideals is also completely identified with inclusion of the binary supports.
